text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright got injured during training, 
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Um, I appreciate your concern, but as you 
can see, I am full of energy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
If you stand still, you will never catch 
up to the others~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
choice_data_list: Rest is the shortcut, you know.
...Can you promise me you won't overdo it?

...Can you promise you won't push yourself 
too hard?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
choice_data_list: Rest is the shortcut, you know.
...Can you promise me you won't overdo it?

...Can you promise you won't push yourself 
too hard?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Understood. If that is what you say, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"During the next training session, I shall 
make up for today as well."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much~ Well then, right 
away—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~, it seems this... hurts a little 
when stretched out~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Phew... It is regrettable, but as 
promised, I shall take a rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Let's take it nice and slooow.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Overdoing it in an attempt to make a 
comeback would defeat the whole purpose, 
after all~.

Thanks to gentle stretching, Mejiro Bright 
successfully made up for the lost time 
afterward.
